title: Replace horizontal organic print with directional lines

request.text: давай поменяем паттерн на лайновый. Хочу управлять толщиной линий, плотностью и направлением

decision: Replace the organic island threshold with gently warped parallel print lines on the four lower plate tops. Replace Pattern scale and Pattern density with independent Line thickness, Line density and Line direction controls; keep the high-contrast print material and all vertical grid behavior.
result: Replaced the organic print with antialiased flowing lines. Added independent width, density and direction controls, removed the obsolete plane scale/density targets, and preserved high-contrast print plus vertical grids. Focused schema, WebGL, browser and embedded endpoint checks passed; defaults and 60% canvas zoom were restored.
checks: Focused schema, product coverage and render-plan assessment
Protected browser cases for planeLineThickness, planeLineDensity and planeLineDirection
Real WebGL coverage, frequency, orientation, contrast and region assertions
risks: High density and thickness endpoints must remain antialiased and retain visible paper gaps.
